assumptions.statement: Approved regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, heritage protection and engineering constraints are not included in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: The package is a concept and intake-level professional design submission; no statutory control, approval, demolition, investment or engineering conclusion is claimed.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Replace provisional polygons and rerun spatial, metric, figure, PDF and HTML generation when official attachments are cleared.

assumptions.statement: SITE_BOUNDARY and the three KEY_AREA polygons are rough temporary constraints derived from the repository snapshot, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All spatial relationships and computed areas are provisional and must be rechecked after official polygons arrive.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official boundary or key-area files published by the organizer.

assumptions.statement: The six global case mechanisms are background inspiration; no external case metric, brand, image, or proprietary data is used as formal evidence.
assumptions.impact: Case comparisons inform transferable design mechanisms only and do not support local planning controls or implementation commitments.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Professional review identifies a local source or licensing condition that changes the comparison.

assumptions.statement: Open-call events, developer community operations, public experience routes and scenario sandboxes are concept recommendations requiring venue, safety, accessibility, privacy and operator review.
assumptions.impact: No event, policy, funding, investment, data-sharing or government implementation is represented as confirmed.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Operator, rights-holder and professional team confirmation of each pilot.
